meta.title: Lowgear Cycle Works | Bike repair in Hackney
meta.description: Bike servicing, while-you-wait puncture and brake fixes, wheel building and steel frame restoration in a railway arch off Mare Street, Hackney.

rationale: A workshop in a railway arch should look like a workshop: a heavy condensed display face, paper-and-oil colours with one signal orange, and a plain price ledger because customers want to know roughly what it costs. Couriers and commuters scan fast, so the page leads with facts and a price list, then gives the frame restoration its own photo-led moment because that is the work Dami loves.

props.label: Prices
props.title: What it costs, roughly
props.intro: Parts are extra. If we find something bigger than you booked in for, we tell you the price before we touch it.

items.name: Brake fix and adjustment
items.description: Pads, cables, bleed and set up. While you wait for most bikes.

items.name: Basic service
items.description: Safety check, gears and brakes adjusted, wheels trued, chain cleaned and lubed.

items.name: Full service
items.description: Strip down, degrease and rebuild. Bearings checked and regreased.

items.name: Wheel build
items.description: Built by hand to suit your hub, rim and the way you ride.

items.name: Steel frame restoration
items.description: Strip, repair, repaint and rebuild. Priced after we have seen the frame.

props.note: Prices are a guide. Bring the bike in and we will confirm before work starts.

pairs.answer: Yes. Punctures and brake fixes are done while you wait. For anything bigger we will tell you how long it needs.

pairs.ask: I ride for work. Can I get it back the same day?
pairs.answer: Many of our customers are couriers and commuters, so we plan around that. Book a service and tell us when you need the bike.
Call us or use the button below, say what the bike needs and when you can drop it off.

pairs.ask: Will I know the price first?
pairs.answer: Yes. We look at the bike, give you a price and wait for your yes before we start.

props.label: Who we are
props.title: Two people, one arch
props.text: I'm Dami. Rosa and I run Lowgear from a railway arch in Hackney. We keep bikes moving, from a quick puncture to a full service, and we build wheels properly. But the part I love is bringing an old steel frame back to life. If you have one in a shed, bring it in and let's have a look.

photo.subject: Dami and Rosa standing in the arch entrance in their work clothes, bikes on stands behind them

items.a: No. You can turn up. Booking just helps us plan your day, especially for services.

items.q: How long does a puncture take?
items.a: We do punctures and brake fixes while you wait, so you can stay and watch.

items.q: Do you work on old steel bikes?
items.a: Yes, and we restore frames too. Bring it in and we will tell you what it needs.

items.q: Can you build wheels for my bike?
items.a: Yes. Tell us about the bike and how you ride and we will suggest a build.
